Mia (AE): Heads-up — AcmeCorp on today's call asked about an air‑gapped POC flow. Main asks: sideloading certs, HSM-backed signing, delta update cadence, and per‑bundle pricing. Need concise answers for procurement and security questionnaire.

Carlos (SE): Quick clarifying Qs — do they require: 1) detached signature only (we provide signed tar.gz + .sig), or 2) HSM attestation / signed timestamp from their KMS?

Jordan (Acme IT): Prefer HSM attestation but would accept our detached sig if the sig chain is verifiable and we can rotate roots. Also need a cert rotation runbook and offline revocation plan. Monthly hotfix cadence OK, critical fixes need faster turnaround.

Carlos (SE): We can do both. For onprem/HSM integration we support customer KMS/HSM keys during install; for fully airgapped customers we produce signed bundles using our signing pipeline and include detached signature + SBOM + sha256 sums. Verification is local. Example verify command we give customers: 

``
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pubkey.pem -signature bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz
``

We also provide an optional minimal verifier binary for customers to run in their preflight.

Jen (InfoSec): Add two requirements: 1) tamper-evident SBOM + signed manifest included; 2) documented provenance for quantized/optimized models (we need reproducible metadata to satisfy our compliance team). Also request an audit log for signing events.

Carlos (SE): Understood. For delta updates: we support chunked deltas and a manifest-driven incremental update. Delta size varies a lot (depends on model/quantization). Typical numbers from previous POCs: full bundle ~12GB (quantized), delta ~200–800MB per patch, but could be larger for model weight changes. We can run a quick diff estimate if you share model hash/variant.

Mia (AE): Procurement wants numbers: one‑time sealed POC packaging fee + per‑bundle delivery price + SOW for onprem install and warranty window. Any standard ballpark we can share quickly?

Ben (Sales Eng): Ballpark (standard offering): one‑time airgap engineering & packaging $18,000; per offline bundle signing + validation run $2,000 each (covers build + SBOM + signed artifact); support SLAs available as add‑on — critical patch SLA (paid priority) 30 days; standard security fixes on the monthly cadence included. These are starting points for SOW negotiation.

Jordan (Acme IT): Is there any way to reduce per‑bundle fee if we commit to quarterly bundles or a reserved plan? Also need statement of work for how signing keys are handled.

Ben (Sales Eng): Yes — we can tier pricing: quarterly commit reduces per-bundle to $750; annual reserved plan negotiable. We'll flag key-handling options in SOW: customer-owned KMS/HSM integration vs Redwood‑signed sealed bundles. SOW will include key custody options + attestations.

Carlos (SE): On the install/runbook side we'll provide: signed bundle, bundle.sha256, sbom.json, manifest.json, and a verifier + a small preflight script. Example preflight snippet we plan to ship: 

``
shasum -a 256 bundle.tar.gz > bundle.sha256
gpg --verify bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz
./verify-bundle --sbom sbom.json --manifest manifest.json
```

OpsBot: Deploy checklist created: https://redwood.internal/docs/offline-checklist (draft). Checklist includes: thumbprint verification, root CA install steps, offline license activation, and rollback steps.

Jen (InfoSec): Contract note: include periodic cert rotation procedure, offline CRL/OCSP handling or equivalent revocation plan, and preserved signing audit logs for X months (please specify retention). I also want explicit language about proofs of build provenance for quantized artifacts.

Mia (AE): Action items: Carlos = delta size estimate + verifier binary drop by EOD tomorrow; Ben = draft SOW + tiered pricing options; Jen = contract language snippets for cert rotation & signing audit; Jordan = confirm PO timeline. Any objections?

Jordan (Acme IT): No objections. We'll aim to get PO submitted by Friday. One ask — can you provide an estimated turnaround for a dry‑run?

Carlos (SE): Dry‑run (internal) to produce a signed bundle + verifier for validation: 48–72 hours from model hash + target quantization profile. For full end‑to‑end onsite validation, add scheduling window ~5 business days.

Mia (AE): Great — I'll summarize in the call notes and share. Carlos please post the sample verification script in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:

Carlos (SE): Will do, dropping the initial verifier and a short README here tomorrow.

Mia (AE): Thanks all — keeping this thread as single source for the handoff to solutions and legal.
